name: Application has one active primary Deal that resolves exactly
description:
Objective: Application has exactly one active primary Deal association and the UI path resolves it to the same Deal detail.
Preconditions: Authenticated QA user; APP-2026-000262 is terminal and MERCHANT_CALL_EXPECTED_DEAL_ID retains the one-shot result.
Steps:
1. Open the exact application.
2. Require exactly one active primary KESEF/DEAL reference equal to the expected UUID.
3. Click Go to Deals, assert /deals, then search by the application DBA.
4. Locate the unique row with that UUID and AK81B01.
5. Click AK81B01.
6. Assert the exact Deal UUID route and reconcile detail API/UI identity, status, type, DBA, and terms.
Expected: The application exposes one active primary Deal reference; Go to Deals and the AK81B01 row control navigate through the UI to the same Deal UUID and details.
